date.as_written: 1998 sāla pauṣa śudī ekādaśī śomavāra 15 gate

notes: The catalogue gives Kathmandu as place of copying, but it is not mentioned in the colophon text. The numerical sequence 1998 | 9 | 3 | 15 | 2 encodes the year (1998), month (9 = Pauṣa), gate (15), and weekday (2 = Monday/Śomavāra).
